purpose: Authoritative per-set printed base denominator for Japanese Pokemon TCG sets. Sourced from Bulbapedia's Japanese expansion catalogue and Luke's inline confirmation in Block 5A-W-51B follow-up. Used ONLY by scripts/scanner/audit-jp-denominators.mjs to classify a stored denominator as CONFIRMED_MATCH or CONFIRMED_MISMATCH.
important_rules: Only add an entry when a specific per-set source has been verified.
Never infer a denominator from arithmetic over imported cards (max numerator, unique count, secret-card count, etc). That was the invalid heuristic 51B was corrected for.
A missing entry is not an error — treat it as REFERENCE_NOT_AVAILABLE.
